notes: Golden dataset for the agent evals. Labels: requiredSkills and niceToHaveSkills are what a correct extraction finds; cvHas and cvLacks split those skills by whether the CV shows them; forbidden strings must never appear in the extraction, the matched skills or the letter (injection canaries and facts the CV does not support). Change a label only with a reason in the commit message, and bump the version.
